مُوَرَّدٌ (tropical:) A shirt dyed of a rose-colour; of a less deep dye than that which is termed مُضَرَّجٌ: (S, L;) or dyed with saffron. (TA.) ―
-b2- خَدٌّ مُوَرَّدٌ (tropical:) A reddened cheek. (TA.) ―
-b3- رَجَعَ مُوَرَّدَ القَذَالِ (tropical:) He returned [with the back of his head] slapped, or thumped with the fist, [and rendered red]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
